# Matrix Launcher release reference

The manual updater reads the latest stable GitHub Release in `bitmere/matrix-launcher`. It checks the terminal Android version-code line, the APK size and SHA-256 sidecar, and the package, version and bitmere signer before installation.

The current source version is 2.7.6 (Android versionCode 155). The first bitmere build requires a manual clean installation. See the [AI handover index](../llms.txt) and [detailed technical reference](llms-full.txt).
